pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Kate Error Lens is a KTextEditor plugin that renders LSP diagnostics (Errors, Warnings, Info, Hints) inline at the end of affected source lines — similar to VSCode's "Error Lens" extension.
It uses KTextEditor::InlineNoteProvider for non-intrusive rendering and subscribes to Kate's built-in LSP client for real-time updates.
Features: - Inline diagnostic rendering at line-ends with severity colour coding - Incremental updates for performance on large files - Configurable severity filter, font scale, and message length truncation - Semi-transparent background with configurable colours - Tooltip on hover showing full diagnostic details - Click to navigate to diagnostic location
